title: Prediction execution output and fixture retirement

functions.yoao_jobs_v1.begin_prediction_mask_produ: Commit one exact current Job lease, generation and result ordinal before generated-Mask production.
functions.yoao_jobs_v1.bind_prediction_mask_object: Bind an exact allocated Mask owner under the current generation; reject stale admission.
functions.yoao_jobs_v1.finish_prediction_mask_prod: Settle the producer only after its prepared result is sealed and its caller has completed physical work.
functions.yoao_jobs_v1.prediction_mask_object_reta: Retain an exact object while any bound producer remains pending.
functions.yoao_assets_v1.fixture_prediction_inputs: Prove exact fixture original identities and the absence of retained original-read operations after fixture sealing.
functions.yoao_jobs_v1.fixture_prediction_retired(: Return true only for a birth-bound terminal prediction Job with terminal native execution and retry receipts, completed managed scopes, qualified input and settled output owners; false or error blocks.
functions.yoao_jobs_v1.guard_fixture_prediction_le: Lock the project Job and failure scope and require each related retry attempt and delivery to have the exact retirement proof.

invariants: Pending or uncertain producer intents and allocated object identities survive worker loss and block cleanup.
Fixture Job birth identities prevent resurrection after deletion; Job deletion atomically snapshots dispatch intents without claiming broker drain.
Retry attempts, delivery receipts, execution facts and completed managed scope retirements remain independent tombstones.
